title: Matterbridge Netatmo plugin
description: Netatmo (stations météo, thermostats, caméras, détecteurs) integration for Matterbridge

clientId.title: Netatmo Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth2 client_id from an app created at https://dev.netatmo.com/

clientSecret.title: Netatmo Client Secret
clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client_secret from your Netatmo app

refreshToken.title: Netatmo Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Initial OAuth2 refresh_token (scopes: read_station read_thermostat write_thermostat read_camera). It is rotated and re-persisted automatically.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll the Netatmo cloud API (minimum 60).

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. For debugging only.
